next_action.description: IMPLEMENT THE HEAD-BRANCH REDESIGN in raw/flow_character_sheet.json, then sync-raw-workflows.mjs. CONFIRM WITH FABIO FIRST that he has saved and closed the bench editor - he had the graph open and DIRTY all of the previous session, which is why nothing was changed then. Three changes, all his calls, all recorded in validation.md with their evidence: (1) RESTRICT THE MASKING TO THE FAR-LEFT REGION. The mechanism is already in the node: `755 SAM3_Detect` has an optional `bboxes` input of type BOUNDING_BOX whose tooltip is 'Bounding boxes to segment within' - a REGION RESTRICTION, not an object selector. So pass the FULL sheet as `image` plus a left-hand box, and the mask returns in sheet coordinates. Core node `PrimitiveBoundingBox` (comfy_extras.nodes_images) supplies it - x=0, y=0, width = a quarter of the sheet width, height = the sheet height, driven off the existing `771 Width_Select` / `772 Height_Select` through an MpiMath. Its INT widgets accept links, exactly as `751.padding` and `720.value` already do. ~25% is the measured-safe cut. (2) DELETE STAGE 1 - `745` / `746` face_yolov8n, `747` and `773` exist only to locate the front head, and the box machinery `749`/`750`/`751`/`752`/`758` plus the `756`/`757` paste-back all exist only to crop to it and paste it home. Feeding SAM3 a bbox against the full sheet removes the need for every one of them, AND removes the zero-face failure, because no detector remains to return nothing. (3) `754` VOCABULARY BECOMES `head, hat`. Verify after: npm test, and validate-injection-rules.mjs on both graphs.

key_decisions: THE VOCABULARY IS `head, hat` (Fabio, 2026-08-21, on his own 1k evidence). Front body returns with no head, no hat and NO BEARD, and its collar, tie, waistcoat and coat intact. The hair left on the shoulders is the mask boundary and is exactly what keeps Klein off the garment - `hair` is the term that dragged the mask onto the clothing and cost 06-knight its mail coif. This REVERSES his own objection to `head` raised earlier the same day (trailing hair IS left behind; he re-judged that acceptable once it became clear the same property protects the wardrobe). `face` does not bind a moustache - run 08 left one floating over an erased face.
STILL NO `neck` IN THE VOCABULARY. Unchanged. Klein grows past whatever mask it is handed, so a neck in the mask destroys what is behind it.
THE FAR-LEFT FIGURE IS THE FRONT BODY - Fabio's observation, confirmed 10 of 10. That is what makes stage 1 deletable rather than merely reducible.

SUBTRACTION (`head` minus `clothes`) was raised and is NOT the chosen path - `head, hat` achieved the same protection with no second SAM3 pass. Keep it as the fallback if the hair remnant proves unacceptable on long-haired characters.
